summary: The root خمر (khmr) primarily means to veil, cover, or conceal something. It extends to concealing thoughts, testimony, or even the intellect by wine.
lane: 1 خَمَرَ خمار خمر , aor. خَمُرَ , (TA,) inf. n. خَمْرٌ , (K,) He veiled, covered, or concealed, a thing; (K, * TA;) as also , inf. n. تَخْمِيرٌ , (Mgh, Msb,) which also signifies he covered over a thing; (S, Msb, K;) and , (TA,) inf. n. إِخْمَارٌ . (K.) [Hence,] خَمَرَهَا [and app. also, for the quasi-pass. is تخمّرت as well as اختمرت , He veiled her with a muffler; ] he put on her a خِمَار . (A.) And إِنَآءَهُ , and وَجْهَهُ , He covered over his vessel, and his face. (S.) And بَيْتَهُ He concealed his house, or chamber, or tent, [meaning its interior,] and ordered it aright. (TA, from a trad.) And الأَرْضُ عَنِّى and مِنِّى and عَلَىَّ The land, or ground, concealed him, or it, from me. (K.) And (assumed tropical:) He concealed it, or conceived it, in him mind. (S, K.) And فُلَانٌ عَلَىَّ ظِنَّةً (assumed tropical:) Such a one concealed, or conceived, in his mind a suspicion, or an evil opinion, of me. (T, TA.) And خَمَرَ شَهَادَتَهُ , (S, Msb,) and , (A, Mgh,) and , (TA,) (tropical:) He concealed his testimony. (S, A, Mgh, Msb, TA.) And الخَمْرُ تَخْمُرُ العَقْلَ (assumed tropical:) Wine veils [or obscures ] the intellect; (K;) and so , lit. covers it: (Msb:) or the latter signifies (assumed tropical:) Infects it; [as though acting like leaven; and if so, from خَمَرَ العَجِينَ , which see in what follows; nearly the same as “ intoxicates, ” which properly signifies “ empoisons, ” or “ infects with poison; ”] syn. تُخَالِطُهُ . (S, * K. [See خَمْرٌ .] -A2- خَمِرَ , aor. خَمَرَ , (S, K,) inf. n. خَمَرٌ , (S,) He became concealed, or hidden; or he concealed, or hid, himself; (S, K;) عَنِّى from me; (S;) as also , (S, K,) inf. n. مُخَامَرَةٌ ; (K;) and : (K:) or this last signifies he concealed, or hid, himself in a خَمَر [or covert of trees or the like ]. (TA.) One says also, خَمِرَ عَنِّى الخَبَرُ (assumed tropical:) The news, or story, became concealed from me. (S.) And one says to the hyena, أُمَّ عَامِرٍ Hide thyself, O Umm-'Ámir: (S, K:) which is a prov.: (TA:) and is said to be also a phrase used as a surname of the hyena, in the manner of تَأَبَّطَ شَرًّا . (Ham p. 242.) And حَضَاجِرْ أَتَاكِ مَا تُحَاذِرْ [ Hide thyself, O hyena: what thou fearest has come to thee ]: thus we have found it: (K:) and this is the reading commonly obtaining accord. to the authors on proverbs: (TA:) but it should properly be خَامِرٌ [and أَتَاكَ ] or تُحَاذِرينَ . (K.) -b2- خَمَرٌ also signifies The becoming changed, or altered, from a former state or condition. (K.) You say, خَمِرَ الشَّىْءُ The thing became changed, &c. (TK.) -A3- خَمَرَ العَجِينَ , (Ks, S, A, Msb, K,) aor. خَمُرَ (S, Msb, K) and خَمِرَ , (S, K,) inf. n. خَمْرٌ , (S, Msb, K,) [ He leavened the dough; ] he put خُمْرَة , (Ks, A,) or خَمِير , (S, A, Msb,) into the dough; (Ks, S, A, Msb, TA;) as also : (TA:) or he left the dough until it became good [or mature ]; (K;) and in like manner, accord. to the K, الطِّينَ [ the clay, or mud : see فَطَرَ ]: or, as in other lexicons, الطِّيبَ [ the perfume ]; (TA;) and the like; as also , inf. n. تَخْمِيرٌ , in relation to any of these things; and in relation to the first [and probably to the others also]: (K:) and خَمَرَ النَّبِيذَ [ he fermented the beverage called نبيذ ;] he put خُمْرَة into the نبيذ . (A.) [Mtr says, in the Mgh, العَصِيرَ I have not found, nor as its quasi-pass.] -b2- خَمَرَهُ , aor. خَمُرَ , (TA,) inf. n. خَمْرٌ ; (K;) and ; (Mgh;) He gave him (namely, a man, and a beast, such as a horse and the like, TA) wine ( خَمْر ) to drink. (K, * Mgh, TA.) -b3- خُمِرَ , (Mgh, TA,) inf. n. خَمْرٌ , (TA,) He suffered, or was affected with, خُمَار [i. e. the remains of intoxication ]. (Mgh, TA.) [See also 5.] -A4- خَمَرَهُ , aor. خَمُرَ , (AA, S,) inf. n. خَمْرٌ , (K,) He was ashamed for himself, or of himself, or was bashful, or shy, with respect to him; was abashed at him, or shy of him. (AA, S, K. *)

headwords.def: مُخَمَّرٌ مخمر (assumed tropical:) A horse having a white head, whatever be the rest of his colour; but not : (Lth:) and مُخَمَّرَةٌ , applied to a ewe or she-goat, (AZ, T, S, A,) accord. to Lth and the K , but the former is the right term, (TA,) [in the CK مُخْتَمِر ,] (assumed tropical:) whose head is white, and the rest of her black; like رَخْمَآءُ : (S:) or having a white head; (AZ, T, A;) and in like manner, a mare: (K:) or a black ewe with a white head : from the خِمَار of a woman. (TA.) See also خَمِيرٌ . And see مَخْمُورٌ .

headwords.gloss: A maker of; wine
headwords.def: مُخَمِّرٌ مخمر A maker of خَمْر [or wine ]. (K.)

headwords.gloss: affected with; the remains of intoxication
headwords.def: مَخْمُورٌ مخمور : see خَمِيرٌ . Also, (S,) and and , (TA,) A man affected with خُمَار , (S, TA,) i. e. the remains of intoxication. (S. [Like مَبْخُورٌ . See also خَمِرٌ .])
مُخْتَمِرٌ مختمر , and with ة : see مُخَمَّرٌ .
مُسْتَخْمِرٌ مستخمر : see خِمِّيرٌ .
